title: Deploy an AI Model with FastAPI

sections.subtitle: The request lifecycle
sections.description:
A production model is a service. A request arrives, gets validated, is transformed into model input, and returns a structured response.

Latency, error handling, and observability matter as much as model quality.

sections.subtitle: A minimal API
sections.description:
FastAPI turns a Python function into an HTTP endpoint. Pydantic validates the request body before your model code runs.

The runnable example below is a dependency-free mock of the prediction function.

sections.subtitle: Production checklist
sections.description:
Before shipping: input validation, timeouts, structured logs, a health endpoint, and a rollback plan.

Also track prediction quality over time. A model can drift even when the code does not change.
